name: 25752-sharedprefix-granite4tiny7b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one engine on one node.
architecture: GraniteMoeHybridForCausalLM: 40 layers (36 mamba2, 4 attention), 62 experts with 6 active per token, ~7B parameters and ~1B active, bf16. Read off the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, rampup_duration 30 s, bounded at 240 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 20% by request count.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn. Four unique prefixes of 32,768 tokens, one drawn at random per request and sent as the system message, plus a fresh 256-token user message: 33,024 declared prompt tokens. Output exactly 16 tokens (min = max, so the backend forces ignore_eos).
purpose: A document question-answering helper on one GPU, where eight concurrent users share long 32k-token reference texts for brief answers.
launch:
# Engine configuration for 25752-sharedprefix-granite4tiny7b-1gpu.

model: ibm-granite/granite-4.0-tiny-preview

tensor-parallel-size: 1

dtype: bfloat16

enable-prefix-caching: true

# Holds the 33,024 declared prompt tokens plus 16 output tokens, with slack for the chat
# template and re-tokenisation, rather than the checkpoint's own 131072.
max-model-len: 40960

# Pinned: this deployment enters the engine through a usage context that is in neither
# per-context defaults table and would otherwise fall through to 2048 and 128.
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 1024

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
